cohort: 932,431 deliveries diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) database (January 2000 to September 2015)
finding: Private insurance is associated with higher incidences of cesarean section among women with gestational diabetes mellitus, irrespective of race/ethnicity.
mod_finding: Cesarean section patients were less likely to develop postpartum hemorrhage compared to their matched controls with vaginal deliveries.
